Corrigan Moving Systems is a full-service relocation company headquartered in Farmington Hills, Michigan. Founded in 1929, the company provides residential and commercial moving services to customers worldwide. Its offerings include local, long-distance, and international moving, as well as packing, storage, car shipping, and piano moving. The company serves a diverse range of commercial clients, including offices, schools, universities, healthcare facilities, and industrial warehouses, providing specialized services such as project management, decommissioning, and asset management. These solutions are delivered through a network of 14 physical locations across Illinois, Michigan, New York, Ohio, and Pennsylvania.
